officialName: SawStop 10" Professional Cabinet Saw (PCS) – Models PCS175 (1.75 HP) / PCS31230 (3 HP)
description: The SawStop Professional Cabinet Saw (PCS) is a 10-inch cast-iron cabinet table saw. In a makerspace, students use it to rip boards to width, crosscut parts with the miter gauge, and cut bevels and dadoes in wood and sheet goods for furniture, boxes and project parts. It cuts up to 3 1/8 in deep with the blade at 0°. If the spinning blade touches skin, a brake stops it in under 5 milliseconds and drops it below the table.
